# Meghan Pasqua | Attorney at Law

Personalized legal counsel with local insight and passionate advocacy. 
 Attorney Meghan Pasqua provides practical guidance for families navigating divorce, child custody, legitimation, adoption, and estate planning matters, with consistent and transparent communication from the start. 

 Meet the team 
 Call (706) 250-1275 

 "Practicing family law means helping people navigate some of the most difficult and transformative moments of their lives. When my clients place their trust in me, I treat that responsibility with the care and respect it deserves."

 - Meghan Pasqua 

 Practice focus 
 Services to help families navigate legal matters. 

 Divorce 
 Advocacy through separation, filing, negotiation, and resolution. 

 Child custody 
 Strategic representation focused on practical outcomes prioritizing children's well-being. 

 Legitimation 
 Support for establishing parental rights and protecting parents' legal standing. 

 Adoptions 
 Legal assistance for families through every step of the adoption process. 

 Estate planning 
 Thoughtful counsel to help families prepare, protect, and plan for the future.

# About

## Meghan Pasqua

Meghan helps clients navigate family law matters with practical advice and effective communication. She values the opportunity to guide her clients through important transitions in their lives, focusing on keeping her clients informed, prepared, and supported at every stage of a case.

Meghan graduated from the Georgia State University College of Law, where she served on the executive boards for the Moot Court Competition Team and Family Law Society. Her law school work included a Best Overall Advocate finish in her school's summer intrastate moot court competition, Second Best Overall Brief at the Albany School of Law National Family Law Moot Court Competition, and a CALI Award in Georgia Appellate Practice & Procedure.

Meghan is the Special Assistant Attorney General (SAAG) for the Murray County Department of Family and Children’s Service. Meghan is a member of the State Bar of Georgia and the Treasurer of the Conasauga Bar Association. She is also certified as a Registered Neutral through the Georgia Office of Dispute Resolution for general civil mediation.

Born and raised in Dalton, Meghan is proud to serve the community she calls home. Her commitment to supporting families extends beyond her legal practice, as she is actively engaged with several local organizations dedicated to strengthening and supporting families. Meghan serves on the executive board of Big Brother Big Sisters of the Northwest Georgia Mountain and on the steering committee of the Young Leaders Society of United Way. She also volunteers at the Humane Society of Northwest Georgia.

When she is not working or volunteering, Meghan enjoys an active life in Dalton with her family, her husband, Darryn, and their two rescue dogs. She enjoys music, long walks, trying new foods, and spending time with the people she loves. 


## Grecia Ramos

Grecia Ramos is a paralegal who supports the firm across client communication, case preparation, court filings, and daily office operations.

Grecia has worked in the legal field for years, handling a wide variety of administrative tasks, including bookkeeping, scheduling, and record keeping. This experience has provided her with an in-depth knowledge of both office administration and court procedures, as well as an ability to handle sensitive information with care.

Grecia obtained her paralegal certificate through the University of Georgia and also has an Associate of Medical Office Administration from Dalton State College. She is also fluent in English and Spanish, allowing our office to serve Spanish-speaking clients with ease and clarity.

In addition to her professional experience and qualifications, Grecia’s kind and calming presence is an asset to clients, as she helps them navigate the logistics of their case. Grecia approaches every client interaction with care, compassion, and professionalism, taking pride in the work she does to support clients. 

Grecia lives in Dalton with her husband Bryant, their children, and their pets. Outside the office, Grecia enjoys gardening, cooking, and quality time with her family.

# Disclaimer

The information provided on this website is for general informational purposes only and is not legal advice. You should consult with an attorney regarding your specific circumstances before taking or refraining from any action based on information on this site.

Contacting Meghan Pasqua, LLC by phone, email, contact form, or other communication does not create an attorney-client relationship. An attorney-client relationship is formed only after the firm has confirmed that it is able to represent you and a written engagement agreement has been signed.

Please do not send confidential, sensitive, or time-sensitive information through this website or by email unless and until an attorney-client relationship has been established.

# Privacy Policy

Last Updated: May 9, 2026

Meghan Pasqua, LLC respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how information submitted through this website may be collected, used, and protected.

## Information Collected

We may collect information you voluntarily provide through this website, including your name, email address, phone number, and any information included in messages or contact forms. We may also collect basic website usage information for internal review, website maintenance, and improvement.

## Use of Information

Information submitted through this website may be used to respond to inquiries, communicate with you, evaluate potential representation, maintain business records, improve the website, or provide information about the firm's services.

Submitting information through this website does not create an attorney-client relationship. You should not submit confidential or time-sensitive information through this website unless and until an attorney-client relationship has been established.

## Sharing of Information

Meghan Pasqua, LLC does not sell personal information. Information may be shared only as reasonably necessary to operate the firm, respond to your inquiry, comply with legal obligations, protect the firm's rights, or as otherwise permitted or required by law.

## Security

Meghan Pasqua, LLC uses reasonable safeguards to protect information submitted through this website. However, no website, email, or electronic transmission is completely secure, and the firm cannot guarantee the security of information transmitted electronically.

## Links to Other Websites

This website may contain links to third-party websites. Meghan Pasqua, LLC is not responsible for the content, security, or privacy practices of those websites.

## Updates to This Policy

Meghan Pasqua, LLC may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be effective when posted on this page.

## Contact

Questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy may be directed to:

Meghan Pasqua, LLC

Email: [grecia@pasqualaw.com](mailto:grecia@pasqualaw.com)
